definitions.gloss: plain; clear; easy to understand; lucid
definitions.explanation: Describing language, writing, or expression that is straightforward and free of complexity or pretension.

examples.japanese: {平明|へいめい}な⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: I try to write in a plain, clear style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平明|へいめい}で⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: His explanations are lucid and easy to understand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{専門用語|せんもんようご}→専門用語：22120_senmonyougo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}け→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧、{平明|へいめい}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{入門書|にゅうもんしょ}→入門書：18849_nyuumonsho⟧だ。
examples.english: It's an introductory book written in plain language, avoiding difficult technical terms.

notes:
Combines {平|へい} (flat, plain) and {明|めい} (bright, clear). Describes language or expression that is clear, easy to follow, and free from unnecessary complexity. Used almost exclusively in written and literary contexts to evaluate the quality of writing or speech.

USAGE:
- Almost always used to describe language, writing, or explanations — not physical objects
- A positive quality — implies clarity and accessibility without being simplistic
- Common in literary criticism, book reviews, and discussions of writing style

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平明|へいめい}な⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧: clear, plain writing
- {平明|へいめい}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: plain language
- {平明|へいめい}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: clear expression
- {平明|へいめい}な⟦{文体|ぶんたい}→文体：12931_buntai⟧: a lucid writing style

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明快|めいかい}→明快：15352_meikai⟧: clear, lucid — similar but slightly stronger emphasis on logical clarity
- ⟦{平易|へいい}→平易：18295_heii⟧: plain, easy — very close synonym; emphasizes ease of understanding
- ⟦{簡潔|かんけつ}→簡潔：05621_kanketsu⟧: concise — focuses on brevity rather than clarity
- ⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい: easy to understand — more conversational; broader usage
